g.text: Layer anatomy of the switch: what the bridge word's change moves, through which part (PREVIEW)
PREVIEW from the Fig 6 runs (main-test depth cells; routes runs where they exist): the code path, not the data.
x = layer / depth. Grey columns: the whole change switches < 30% of the reader (not read). Dotted line = L.
Thin grey = a random part of the same share. UNVERIFIED.
